label: Lung cancer mortality
definition: Deaths from lung cancer attributable to long-term PM2.5 and TRAP
citation: Chen 2020 10.1016/j.envint.2020.105974 and Boogaard 2022 10.1016/j.envint.2022.107262 both list lung cancer mortality as a high-certainty PM2.5 and TRAP outcome, no existing E node holds it

label: Heat and dust co-occurrence
definition: Days on which high temperature and elevated dust coincide
citation: Alahmad 2024 10.1136/bmjdrc-2024-004320 shows hot-dusty days raise diabetes admission risk to 1.36 versus 1.11 for heat alone, an interaction no single S node captures

label: Adult asthma onset
definition: New asthma cases in adults attributable to TRAP
citation: Boogaard 2022 10.1016/j.envint.2022.107262 rates asthma onset in adults as high or moderate-to-high confidence, E04 is child-only
